comment: Static dictionary catalog for InstantJPDict (#71).
Hand-maintained. Every entry is a downloadable Yomitan zip, pinned to a
DATED upstream release URL (never /releases/latest/) plus a byte size and
SHA-256, so an install can be integrity-checked before a single row reaches
the database. `title` is the dictionary's stable title family, which the
installed DictionaryMeta.name is matched against (the upstream zip may
append a revision in brackets, e.g. "JMdict [2026-09-15]").
Two entries may share a title family when they are mutually exclusive
variants (the two JMdict builds): the importer replaces by title, and the
installed DictionaryMeta.catalogId records which one is installed, so only
one row lights up. The first entry of a family is the title-only default.
"recommended": true marks the entries the app steers new users to; an
uninstalled recommended row shows a green "Recommended" badge, and once it
is installed that badge gives way to "Installed".
Jitendex is a family of its own: its index.json title is
"Jitendex.org [2026-08-11]", so the stable family is "Jitendex.org"
(the row's display name stays "Jitendex") and it never collides with JMdict.
The Kanjium pitch dictionary is deliberately NOT listed: it is bundled in
the APK and installed automatically at first launch, so there is nothing
for the user to install. The catalog is only for downloads.
Licence labels point at the in-app Licenses viewer (#70), which ships the
full CC BY-SA 4.0 / EDRDG texts.
